title: JAREX: An Acquisition Function for Multi-Objective Algorithmic Process Characterization
abstract: arXiv:2609.24954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pharmaceutical process characterization is central to Quality by Design because it defines how variations in process parameters affect the ability to meet product quality specifications, thereby supporting proven acceptable ranges and robust manufacturing. In practice, however, characterization still relies largely on factorial design of experiments (DOE) approaches, which are inefficient for resolving multivariate pass/fail boundaries in higher-dimensional spaces. While Bayesian optimization has transformed process optimization, adaptive methods for multi-objective process characterization remain lacking. Here, we introduce JAREX (Joint Acceptable Region EXploration), a Bayesian active-learning acquisition function for multi-objective process characterization. translated_title: JAREX：一种用于多目标算法化工艺表征的采集函数
translated_abstract: 制药工艺表征是质量源于设计（Quality by Design）的核心，因为它定义了工艺参数的变异如何影响满足产品质量规格的能力，从而支持可接受范围的确认与稳健的生产制造。然而在实践中，工艺表征仍主要依赖析因实验设计（DOE）方法，这类方法在高维空间中解析多变量合格/不合格边界时效率低下。尽管贝叶斯优化已经变革了工艺优化领域，但用于多目标工艺表征的自适应方法仍然缺乏。在此，我们提出JAREX（Joint Acceptable Region EXploration，联合可接受区域探索），这是一种面向多目标工艺表征的贝叶斯主动学习采集函数。JAREX将工艺表征表述为一个联合边界学习问题，并自适应地选择实验，以恢复由同时满足多项要求所定义的联合合格区域。
tldr: 该论文提出JAREX，一种贝叶斯主动学习采集函数，将多目标制药工艺表征表述为联合边界学习问题，能够自适应选择实验以高效解析多变量联合合格区域，从而替代低效的析因DOE方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces JAREX, a Bayesian active-learning acquisition function that formulates multi-objective pharmaceutical process characterization as a joint boundary-learning problem, adaptively selecting experiments to efficiently recover the joint pass region in place of inefficient factorial DOE approaches.
